obligations.text: Every rustev.definition/1 document compiles to the same rustev.plan/2 bytes and PlanId as before this spec, with the same judgment, evidence and refusals; snapshot 1 documents keep their bytes and SnapshotId.

An extracted field is either present with a value that satisfies its declared type, bounds and vocabulary exactly as received, or absent with a reason; no value is coerced, clamped, truncated, defaulted or repaired.

A field filled by the model is model-derived; a field filled by the fallback extractor is exact-derived only when every source it read is exact-derived; acceptance never lowers a value's derivation class.

A per-field distribution exists only from log-probabilities the backend returned for every declared option, normalized by the core; a self-reported confidence is recorded as provider-reported and never becomes mass.

In a version 2 definition, no exact operator, policy predicate, proposal parameter, acquisition request or other model step reads a model value except through a declared acceptance rule, and no selection-policy control reads one at all; the compiler refuses every other read with unaccepted_model_value.
The fallback extractor is a pure, bounded, identified program evaluated in rustev-core with identical results on every target, and its identity is part of the PlanId.

An accept_model_derived step declares its validation and its consequence on failure, applies them to every model-derived value it reads, passes caller and system values through unchanged, and emits a field_dropped notice with its computed action for every dropped value.
Snapshot producers are accepted only on model-derived entries and are recorded per input and in the lineage of every value that read the input.
Questions of a needs_input outcome are always declared templates; an extraction may only select among a declared set, through an accept step, and never supplies question text.

sectionHeadings: 038: Structured extraction step and the model-derived input pattern (amends 002 and 003)
record.summary: An amendment of approved specs 002 and 003 (R-16), for #76 child B6. Two supported ways to turn free text into typed decision inputs, both keeping extracted values model-derived. Pattern A: the host extracts and submits snapshot entries with provenance `model-derived` and an optional producer identity (artifact, template digest, production time), recorded in evidence and lineage. Pattern B: an `extract` step, a model step of spec 037's bounded envelope, asks a backend for a typed record against a declared schema and vocabularies under an identified prompt template; every field is validated and is present or absent with a reason, never coerced, clamped or truncated; each field carries its origin (`extracted`, `fallback`, `absent`) and derivation; a deterministic in-core fallback extractor (`rustev.extract-rules/1`) yields exact-derived fields; per-field distributions exist only from backend log-probabilities and are thresholded only under a bound calibration or a declared `uncalibrated_threshold`. In both patterns an exact operator, policy predicate, proposal parameter, acquisition request or other model step reads a model value only through a declared acceptance rule (an `accept_model_derived` step, or a spec 033 check covering `model-derived`); selection-policy controls never read one. Extraction can drive spec 033's `needs_input` outcome and propose which declared questions it asks. Adds to the shared #76 versions; every version 1 definition keeps its bytes, its plan and its `PlanId`. Approved (A-35); implementation is pending.
